title: The 0.4993 barrier for arbitrary radial profiles in a fixed tetrahedron cylinder family
contribution_type: written proof extension and scoped structural negative result
predecessor_credit: Ricardo Pinho: original construction, fixed secant axes, normalization, and original certificates. The shared-profile audit and independent-even-profile extension are retained dependencies.
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, review, and archival packaging. Separate AI review is not human peer review.
claim: Covering forces C >= 4993/10000 for arbitrary positive node-radius profiles in both specified cylinder families, without shared radii or evenness.

mathematical_scope.radii: arbitrary positive node radii in each of two families
mathematical_scope.bases: triangular intercept bases projected perpendicular to the fixed secant axes
mathematical_scope.normalization: sum of perpendicular-base areas divided by sqrt(2)
mathematical_scope.proof_kind: written continuum proof plus exact finite arithmetic

public_disclosure.scope: Arbitrary positive profiles; removes evenness as well as shared radii.

upstream_acceptance.meaning: Repository acceptance; no human peer-review certification is inferred.

limitations: Only the specified 2048-sector axes, polynomial, tilt interval [0,1], positive node radii and triangular intercept bases.
Written continuum proof supported by exact finite computation; not a formal proof.
No improved covering construction or bound for arbitrary axes.
No exhaustive novelty or priority assessment.
The separate explicit-cover certificate is archived as source context and was not rerun for this deposit.
